simple: Cloud email security for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and other email services via API — a component of FortiMail Workspace Security (formerly Perception Point). Scans every email: static analysis (antivirus engines, reputation, SPF, DKIM, DMARC), dynamic analysis — attachments and links are recursively unpacked and opened in an isolated environment on the patented hardware-assisted platform HAP, which catches the exploit before code runs — and AI (language models, computer vision against QR-code phishing) against business email compromise, impersonation and payload-less attacks. Detects account takeover from sign-in events. The FortiMail Workspace Security suite includes Fortinet’s 24/7 incident response service at no extra cost: it analyzes alerts, tunes policies and helps with remediation.
classification: ICES is email protection, HAP dynamic analysis is the sandbox class, account takeover is UEBA (as with Harmony Email).
The response service is a service and stays in the text.
